title: Surrender…To Fight Another Day
front_description: The droid factory skirmish is finally ended. Padmé, having survived various perils on the conveyor belt, is now surrounded by winged Geonosians and taken prisoner. Cornering Anakin are a group of formidable droidekas. Finally, from somewhere above, Jango Fett drops down to face this young intruder, blaster in hand. "Don't move, Jedi!" he says with a snarl.
back_description: A beautiful digital rendering of a winged Geonosian warrior.
